name: Alaska
standard: Section 508 + latest WCAG Level A and AA

laws.cite: AS 18.80.255; AS 39.28.055; 6 AAC 65.010 et seq.; Administrative Orders 129 and 262
laws.summary: Authorities cited by the Department of Administration's statewide ICT accessibility policy.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: Accessibility of Information and Communication Technology (DOA policy, 2022-08-04)

applies_to: All State of Alaska executive branch agencies, including public corporations, boards and commissions; covers ICT hosted on state servers, procured by the state, or supported by state funds.

deadlines.what: Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Train staff and use the latest WCAG A/AA for websites and online apps
Test all ICT for accessibility monthly with WCAG-current tools
Provide a way for users to report accessibility issues
OIT selects and procures accessible ICT and verifies compliance
mobile: implied — the ICT definition includes 'applications' but mobile apps are not named.
procurement: OIT must select and procure accessible ICT; no VPAT/ACR requirement stated.
enforcement: State ADA Coordinator may review compliance; users report issues through each agency's reporting mechanism.
notes: No Alaska statute that sets a web standard; the requirement is a DOA policy. 'Latest version' of WCAG is a moving target and the policy allows higher standards such as WCAG 2.2. office_url is inferred from the policy's path and was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
